part.text:
The issue has been fixed. The change ensures that `MaxLengthValidator` is only appended when `max_length` is not None, which prevents the TypeError when using `Value('test')` with `_resolve_output_field()`.

The fix modifies the `CharField.__init__` method in `/testbed/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py` to check if `self.max_length is not None` before appending the validator, matching the pattern already used in `BinaryField.__init__`.

This resolves the performance issue mentioned in the problem description, as well as prevents the TypeError when using Value expressions with string values.
